title: Save and load a table

solution.solution.lua:
local function is_list(t)
    local n = #t
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(t) do count = count + 1 end
    return count == n
end

local function write(v, seen)
    local t = type(v)
    if t == "number" or t == "boolean" or t == "nil" then return tostring(v) end
    if t == "string" then return string.format("%q", v) end
    if t ~= "table" then error("cannot save a " .. t) end
    if seen[v] then error("cannot save a table that contains itself") end
    seen[v] = true
    local parts = {}
    if is_list(v) then
        for i = 1, #v do parts[i] = write(v[i], seen) end
    else
        local keys = {}
        for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
        table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
        for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
            local key = (type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$")) and k or "[" .. write(k, seen) .. "]"
            parts[#parts + 1] = key .. "=" .. write(v[k], seen)
        end
    end
    seen[v] = nil
    return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
end

function serialize(v)
    return write(v, {})
end

function deserialize(text)
    local chunk, err = load("return " .. text, "data", "t", {})
    if not chunk then return nil, err end
    local ok, value = pcall(chunk)
    if not ok then return nil, value end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil, "not a table" end
    return value
end

hints: Write one recursive function that takes the value and a `seen` table; add a table to `seen` before writing its contents and remove it afterwards (lesson 8.03).
A table is a list when counting its keys with `pairs` gives the same number as `#t`.
unitTests:
test("lists and records", function()
    check_eq(serialize({ 1, 2, "x" }), '{1,2,"x"}')
    check_eq(serialize({ b = 2, a = 1 }), "{a=1,b=2}")
    check_eq(serialize({ ["two words"] = true, a = { 3 } }), '{a={3},["two words"]=true}')
    check_eq(serialize({ [10] = "ten" }), '{[10]="ten"}')
    check_eq(serialize("say \"hi\"\n"), '"say \\"hi\\"\\\n"')
end)

test("round trip", function()
    local data = { name = "Ada", items = { "map", "sword" }, level = 3, ok = false, nested = { deep = { 1.5 } } }
    check_eq(deserialize(serialize(data)), data)
end)

test("refuses what cannot be saved", function()
    check_error(serialize, { f = print })
    local loop = {}
    loop.self = loop
    check_error(serialize, loop)
    local shared = { 1 }
    check_eq(serialize({ shared, shared }), "{{1},{1}}")
end)

test("loading is safe", function()
    check_eq(deserialize("{ x = os.exit() }"), nil)
    check_eq(deserialize("{ unclosed = "), nil)
    check_eq(deserialize("42"), nil)
end)
